title: Companion publish gate review
description: Opens three runs parked at a publish gate under a one-review policy on a private fixture gateway; each gate's actions come from the gateway's own policy functions. The first has one proven criterion (a screenshot and a text check), one criterion with no verdict, passing reviewers and a worker packet asking to approve: run detail and the decision workspace both reach the gate review, approve-publish is disabled with its reason on the gate review, the Gate tab and for the packet, while hold and review requests stay enabled; the criterion's evidence opens in the artifact viewer and swipes within that criterion; holding the gate resolves it on the gateway. The second has every criterion proven but a claude review with open findings: the gateway still offers approve-publish and the gate review withholds it. The third has every criterion proven and no passing review: the gateway's review bypass stays enabled; a package replaced while its hold confirmation is open is refused at Send; and after trips to the background the gate review shows a ledger change and a hold made while the app was away. The text evidence is larger than the viewer's 200,000-byte preview, which says so. Requires the leased iOS simulator and the dev client with the recipe bridge; the relaunch step starts the app on a saved profile for the fixture gateway, replacing the profiles saved before the run.

proofTargets.claim: A gate review screen for an engine_human_gate decision shows the package summary, each reviewer's latest verdict, the acceptance criteria, the shared evidence workspace and the decision's actions, reached from run detail and the decision workspace.

Approve-publish is disabled with a visible reason while a registered criterion has no verdict or a reviewer's latest verdict is not an approval, on the gate review, the decision workspace and for worker packets; hold, review requests and, once every criterion is judged, the gateway's review bypass stay enabled.
Tapping a criterion's evidence opens the artifact viewer on that file with the criterion's verdict, proof mode and recipe node, and swiping stays within that criterion's evidence.
Gate actions resolve through the existing decision-resolve call: holding the gate resolves the decision on the gateway.
Text evidence downloads through one byte range of at most 200,000 bytes, with a note giving the file's full size when it is cut.
Send acts on the package the operator confirmed: a package replaced while the confirmation is open is refused and the gate stays open.
When the app returns from the background, the gate review re-reads the run and its acceptance ledger, so a ledger change and a resolution made while it was away are shown.
